ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white pixels covering approximately 85% of the visible surface, bordered by low-intensity black pixels at the trailing edges and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Ventral surface contains a large, contiguous white central region; trailing edge features a thin, jagged black border; a single dark circular focal spot is visible on the left lobe; extensive black mottling is present on the far-left distal tip; a smaller black patch is on the far-right distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible deep V-shaped depression at the center-point of the fluke lobes with a sharply defined vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel amplitudes along the entire trailing boundary of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve sweeping upward and outward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Presence of white stippled clusters on the black background of the far-left distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, dark circular pigmentation mark or scar located on the interior region of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The leftmost tip exhibits a highly complex and fragmented pigmentation pattern compared to the relatively solid black marking on the right tip.
